findings.finding: TLC stage 6 needed an honest satisfaction mechanism for all three exact demo orders.
findings.evidence: Packet v1.0.3 binds the already-granted Human approval source SHA, exact FO blob, order ID and document hash for the three demo orders only; the separate intervention remains exceptional handling.

findings.finding: Cross-family identity, push destination, Mission Control proofs, and issue-source uniqueness were underspecified.
findings.evidence: Packet v1.0.3 pins provider executable/model/credential bindings, normalized transpara-ai repository URLs, named Hive/Site tests, and one active order per durable issue identity.

findings.finding: Attempt preimage, concurrency semantics, baseline ordering, dual-store ordering, Human attribution, and waiting-slot release required hardening.
findings.evidence: Packet v1.0.3 incorporates every enumerated hardening item and makes the corresponding acceptance evidence explicit.

residual_risks: GitHub effects are reconciled and idempotent but cannot be transactionally committed with local EventGraph and Work state.
The v1 scheduler is intentionally single-instance; multi-host leader election remains v2.
The demonstration supports one author family and one independent reviewer family.
The installed governance cache has a noncanonical bytecode extra; exact gate artifacts are authoritative.
non_authorizations: No production deployment or CanOperate expansion.
No direct default-branch push, branch-protection change, or merge of demonstration PRs.
No mutation or reuse of Operation #86 or other consumed evidence.
No credential reuse, disclosure, or evidence fabrication.
No value allocation or residual-risk closure.
